headline: US Strikes Hit 12 Iranian Sites, Targeting Missile and Nuclear Facilities
subheadline: CENTCOM says strikes aim to degrade Iran’s ability to attack civilian shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, hitting Khondab nuclear site and petrochemical facilities.
lede: U.S. forces launched widespread strikes across southern Iran, hitting at least 12 locations including Ahvaz, Bandar Abbas, and Khondab nuclear site near Arak. The operation targeted missile systems, air defenses, and IRGC naval assets near the Strait of Hormuz, killing IRGC logistics officer Maziyar Bobardak in Ahvaz and naval air defense officer Hamid Reza Dehghan in Jask. CENTCOM stated the aim is to degrade Iran’s ability to attack civilian shipping, while Iranian officials confirm strikes on strategic infrastructure such as petrochemical facilities. Simultaneously, Israel eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza and destroyed a weapons production site in Gaza City.

sections.title: Russia Deep‑Strike Campaign on Odesa and Dnipro
sections.body: Russia executed a coordinated missile and drone offensive aimed at Odesa’s Chornomorsk and Pivdenne ports, threatening 4‑8 missiles delivered by Su‑30, Su‑34, Su‑35, Su‑57/34 aircraft and Orion UAVs over the Black and Azov seas. Tactical aviation then bombed Synelnykove district in Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia with guided aerial bombs, while Shahed drones disrupted ammunition deliveries in Druzhkivka and repelled an attack near Krasnohorivka. Ukraine responded by striking the Azov Sea port in Russia’s Rostov region with an FP‑1 drone and securing five Patriot missiles from Poland, as Germany pledged 50,000 FPV drones. Additional Russian strikes cut power to over 61,000 subscribers in Chernihiv, underscoring the campaign’s focus on critical infrastructure.

sections.title: US Strikes Decimate Iranian Missile and Nuclear Assets
sections.body: U.S. forces struck at least 12 Iranian locations, including Ahvaz, Bandar Abbas, and the Khondab nuclear site near Arak, targeting missile systems, air defenses, and IRGC naval assets near the Strait of Hormuz. The attacks killed IRGC logistics officer Maziyar Bobardak in Ahvaz and naval air defense officer Hamid Reza Dehghan in Jask, while Iranian officials confirmed damage to petrochemical facilities and strategic infrastructure. CENTCOM said the operation aims to degrade Iran’s ability to attack civilian shipping, and Israel eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza and destroyed a weapons production site in Gaza City.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous U.S. strikes on 12 Iranian sites, including the Khondab nuclear complex and senior IRGC logistics and naval officers, signal a decisive escalation focused on degrading missile, air defense, and nuclear capabilities near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran’s reported restraint on civilian casualties and parallel Israeli actions in Gaza suggest a calibrated campaign aimed at limiting escalation while pressuring Hamas reconstruction. Russia’s multi‑platform missile and drone offensive on Odesa, coupled with sustained guided‑bomb attacks on Dnipro and Zaporizhzhia, demonstrates a high‑intensity deep‑strike effort that exploits Ukrainian air defense shortfalls despite recent Patriot transfers.
